section.title: Popular Direct Mail Formats
section.description: We custom print and process several major mail styles. Tailor dimensions, paper weights, and folding specifications for your unique branding goals.
section.note: Core fields (title, description, sizes/options/details/features) are sourced directly from the live page. Supplemental fields below (turnaround, paper stock, pricing tier, FAQs, etc.) are reasonable industry-standard additions not published on the source page — verify with FBS Signs before using as-is.

formats.title: Postcards
formats.description: Perfect for quick product announcements, coupon discounts, and retail store openings. Extremely cost-effective.

faqs.question: Do I need a mailing list for postcards?
faqs.answer: No — EDDM lets you target every address on a mail route without a purchased list.

faqs.question: What's the most popular postcard size?
faqs.answer: 6"x9" balances visibility with cost and works for both EDDM and targeted mail.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum order quantity for postcards?
faqs.answer: Yes — runs start at 500 pieces, which keeps per-piece cost low while still qualifying for EDDM and bulk mail rates.

formats.title: Letter Mailers
formats.description: Ideal for business letters, newsletters, utility notices, and solicitations. Keeps your communications secure.
formats.detailsValue: Single window, Double window, reply envelope
formats.printSides: Full color or black & white, single or double-sided

faqs.question: Can each letter be personalized?
faqs.answer: Yes — variable data printing supports individualized names, account numbers, and offers.

faqs.question: Do you handle stuffing and sealing?
faqs.answer: Yes — folding, insertion, and sealing are included in the mailer production run.

faqs.question: Can I include a reply envelope with my letter?
faqs.answer: Yes — reply envelopes can be inserted alongside the letter for donations, payments, or returned forms.

formats.title: Catalogs & Booklets
formats.description: Saddle-stitched or perfect bound booklets are fantastic for showcasing complete product ranges or seasonal guides.
formats.detailsValue: Coated or uncoated stock, up to 64 pages

faqs.question: What's the difference between saddle-stitch and perfect binding?
faqs.answer: Saddle-stitch staples folded sheets and suits thinner booklets; perfect binding glues a flat spine and suits thicker catalogs.

faqs.question: Is there a page limit?
faqs.answer: Up to 64 pages is standard; higher page counts can be quoted on request.

faqs.question: Can I order a small test run before committing to a full print?
faqs.answer: Yes — short runs starting at 250 copies are available so you can proof the layout and stock before scaling up.

formats.title: Folded Self-Mailers
formats.description: Bi-fold, tri-fold, or gate-folded print designs that seal with clear wafer tabs. No envelope needed.

faqs.question: Do self-mailers need an envelope?
faqs.answer: No — wafer seals hold the folded panels closed so the piece mails on its own.

faqs.question: Can I include a tear-off coupon?
faqs.answer: Yes — perforation lets recipients detach a coupon or reply panel.

faqs.question: Which fold type works best for my content?
faqs.answer: Bi-folds suit simple two-panel offers, tri-folds fit brochure-style content, and gate-folds give the most panels for multi-product layouts.
